articles.title: US embassy in Riyadh hit by drones: Saudi defence ministry
articles.summary: Two drones attacked the US embassy in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, causing a limited fire and material damage. The kingdom's defence ministry confirmed the incident on March 3 via a post on X, citing an initial assessment. This event underscores persistent security threats and regional instability, providing crucial context for understanding geopolitical dynamics.

articles.title: Satellite images show destruction at huge oil refinery, Iranian nuclear facility
articles.summary: Newly released satellite imagery confirms the aftermath of an Iranian drone attack on Saudi Aramco's Ras Tanura refinery, one of the world's largest oil facilities. This incident highlights persistent regional tensions and the evolving threat of drone warfare against critical infrastructure, offering a key case study for understanding contemporary defence challenges.

articles.title: U.S. Embassy In Riyadh Hit By Drones, Saudi Defense Ministry Says
articles.summary: The U.S. embassy in Riyadh, Saudi Arabia, was targeted by two drones on March 3rd, resulting in a limited fire and material damage. Reported by the Saudi defence ministry, this incident underscores ongoing regional security concerns and the vulnerability of diplomatic missions to drone attacks. It signifies potential escalations affecting international interests in the Middle East.

articles.title: France to boost nuclear arsenal and extend deterrence to European allies
articles.summary: France has announced plans to significantly boost its nuclear arsenal and extend its nuclear deterrence capability to encompass European allies. This strategic move aims to strengthen European collective security and strategic autonomy. SSB aspirants should consider its implications for NATO's role, European defence integration, and the evolving geopolitical landscape concerning nuclear proliferation and strategic partnerships.

articles.title: Big Three pharmacies to close 880 locations...
articles.summary: Major US pharmacy chains, including CVS Health, Rite Aid, and Walgreens, are planning to close hundreds of locations nationwide. This widespread closure is attributed to significant industry-wide problems and mounting economic pressures. The move highlights challenges faced by the retail pharmacy sector, potentially impacting access to healthcare services and local economies.

articles.title: France to boost nuclear arsenal, involve European allies in deterrence
articles.summary: French President Emmanuel Macron announced France will increase its nuclear arsenal and, for the first time, permit temporary deployment of its nuclear-armed aircraft. This strategic decision underscores France's commitment to strengthening its deterrence capabilities amid evolving global security challenges. For SSB aspirants, this highlights significant shifts in European defence policies and international power dynamics, impacting global strategic stability and alliance structures.
